name: SM_Prop_Lantern_Hanging_01
dresses: hanging lantern, 0.19 x 0.19 x 0.78 m with its chain: riveted iron tray and pierced pyramid cap, four corner bars, four scraped-horn panes each with a glazing bar, door hinges and hasp (baked), a candle stub inside, seven links of chain to a ceiling hook and plate

fit.pivot: the ceiling plate (top of the hook): the lantern hangs down -Z from the origin; the lantern body spans z = -0.78 to -0.39
fit.panes: slot MI_Prop_Lantern_Hanging_01_Horn is kind translucent (thin, two-sided, diffusing amber horn: transmission colour = BC, about 60 percent of light carried through); T_Prop_Lantern_Hanging_01_E holds the glow of the panes around the candle (emissive = E * 60 nits when lit, 0 unlit)

emissive.type: flame, done in engine (no flame mesh in the FBX)
emissive.note: point light at the socket with shadow casting off for the lantern mesh itself; pane glow from E as in fit.panes

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2, four review rounds (r5-r6). Last look still faults: the pyramid cap is plain flat sheet (vents and rivets are baked only, no seam or lapped edge), frame bars are clean square section, the horn panes are flat with a cloudy amber pattern that is a little even from pane to pane, chain links are plain ovals; inside there is only a candle stub (no pricket). Lit state depends on the integrator honouring the translucent slot and E.
